purpose: Close Auditor v7r5 anonymous REST polling rate-budget blocker and Independent Lab v7r6 pagination-watermark/rate-header blockers without weakening Owner provenance, duplicate detection, replay protection, exact image/Python/Step3 closure, or fail-closed behavior.

api_budget_remediation.anonymous_primary_limit_assumption: 60 requests/hour per IP is treated as an external ceiling, never as available authority
api_budget_remediation.initial_history: one paginated full snapshot only; the next incremental cursor is pinned to the trusted GitHub server Date from page 1 of the scan, never the final-page Date
api_budget_remediation.subsequent_polling: GitHub issue-comments since scan-start cursor with 2-second overlap; each multi-page delta keeps the page-1 server Date as the next cursor and merges both newly-created and edited comments by comment ID
api_budget_remediation.pagination_race_policy: an edit occurring after an early page was read but before later pages complete must remain after the next since lower bound and therefore be re-fetched on the next cycle; deterministic full-scan and multi-page-delta race selftests enforce this
api_budget_remediation.rate_header_policy: every successful anonymous GitHub API response used by the gate requires parseable X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Reset; missing, malformed, negative, or internally inconsistent values fail closed before response evidence is consumed
api_budget_remediation.error_policy: HTTP 403 rate-limit, HTTP 429, hard-budget exhaustion, reserve exhaustion, missing/malformed/inconsistent rate headers, transport/status/parse failures all fail closed; no blind retry loop
api_budget_remediation.mechanical_scenario: deterministic 601-comment initial corpus (600 filler + freeze, seven pages), late Owner approval/session at minute 8.5, updated-comment replacement, full/multi-page pagination-edit races, missing/malformed rate headers, and full 10-minute budget; all normal request counts remain below hard budget 40 and external 60/hour ceiling

external_authority.freeze_provenance: owner-attributed chatgpt-codex-connector evidence only; never Owner authority; created_at must equal updated_at and exactly one mapping may exist for the local immutable image identity
external_authority.owner_approval_provenance: first-party Owner-authored GitHub issue comment only: exact owner login and performed_via_github_app must be null; created_at must equal updated_at; connector-origin approval is rejected
external_authority.owner_approval_binding: current CodespaceName + fresh 128-bit challenge + exact image identity + exact candidate head/tree + exact freeze comment + exact phrase + one-shot + Runtime OFF
external_authority.approval_uniqueness: all structurally matching Owner-only approvals in the maintained snapshot are counted without prefiltering by referenced ID; exactly one must exist and its ID must equal the session receipt OwnerApprovalComment
external_authority.edit_detection: incremental since polling uses a scan-start lower-bound cursor with overlap, includes updated comments, and replaces prior snapshots by ID, so edits during pagination and later edits are re-evaluated and fail closed when required
external_authority.freshness: Owner approval must be created at or after trusted GitHub server challenge time and no later than the unedited session-binding receipt
